summary: Iteration 7 — Retest of the togglePublish ReferenceError crash from iter6. FIX VERIFIED. togglePublish is now declared inside the Strategies component (strategies.tsx:141-165) and correctly wired to onPress at line 426. End-to-end UI flow exercised on the live preview URL: login as creator → /editor → save 'Test Pub' (2 default legs) → card appears in Strategies list with CUSTOM badge ✓ → open detail modal → 'Publish to Marketplace' button (testID=toggle-publish-btn) visible below Backtest ✓ → tap publish → NO ReferenceError / NO red-screen ✓ → success alert dismissed ✓ → MODAL STAYS OPEN and button label flips IN-PLACE to 'Unpublish from Marketplace' (no reload, exactly per spec) ✓ → tap unpublish → no crash, label flips back to 'Publish to Marketplace' ✓. Built-in strategies (Iron Condor, Bull Put Spread, etc.) correctly hide the publish button via `{(selected as any).is_custom && ...}` conditional render — verified by inspecting the list (only Test Pub carries the CUSTOM badge) and by reading strategies.tsx:422. Iter6 critical bug is closed.

minor.issue: Carried over from iter5/6: find_strategy() does not require username when strategy_id starts with 'custom_' — minor cross-user info leak.

action_items: [Optional / carryover] Tighten find_strategy() so custom_* ids require a username (cross-user info leak surface).
[Optional] Add testIDs to bottom-tab buttons (tab-strategies, tab-portfolio, etc.) to remove the text='Strategies' fallback in future UI tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks clean: togglePublish is declared as an async arrow inside the Strategies component (closure over selected/setSelected/setStrategies), correctly branches on (selected as any).is_public, awaits api.publishStrategy / api.unpublishStrategy, refreshes the customs list, and updates the selected modal in-place via setSelected(updated). This matches the spec exactly — modal does not reload.
Conditional render `{(selected as any).is_custom && <publish button>}` at line 422 correctly hides the publish CTA for built-in strategies.
No TypeScript build is run in CI — recommend `tsc --noEmit` to catch this class of ReferenceError pre-merge.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 5 frontend acceptance criteria for the togglePublish fix pass.

seed_data_creation: UI test created one user (creator46250) and one custom strategy 'Test Pub' (published then unpublished, ends in unpublished state).

Marketplace cross-user install/clone flow and Portfolio LIVE WebSocket badge were already validated in iter6 and were not re-tested here since they were not impacted by this fix. Backend was 23/23 in iter6 — no backend regression expected from this UI-only change.
rca_of_issue: Iter6 root cause: onPress={togglePublish} referenced an undeclared identifier. Iter7 fix: handler is now declared inside the component (lines 141-165), calls the existing api.publishStrategy / api.unpublishStrategy wrappers, then refreshes both the list (setStrategies) and the open modal (setSelected) so the button label flips without unmounting the modal. Verified: clicking the button no longer raises ReferenceError and the label flips correctly in both directions.
